cut.description: Instant change to the next scene.

dissolve.description: Cross-fades from one scene into the next.

wipe.description: A directional wipe (`dir` left, right, up or down).

iris.description: A circle closes on `target` and opens on them in the next scene.

card.description: A full-screen card between scenes (`kind` title, chapter, time or end).

title.description: The story title (`title`, optional `subtitle`); usually the first scene's transitionIn.

end.description: The end card (`text`); usually the last scene's transitionOut.

rule: At a scene boundary the next scene's transitionIn wins, then the previous scene's transitionOut, else cut. Transitions add video time but no story time.
